instruction: Launch GIMP, load 'character.png' from your desktop, lower the brightness, then save the result as 'character_dark.png'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening character.png in GIMP, reducing brightness, and saving as character_dark.png. Evaluator uses custom wrapper function check_brightness_decrease_and_structure_sim__acfc7bbb8c0cd569e87c4f8210570f3d which verifies: (1) the result image has lower brightness than the original, and (2) the structure is preserved (same content, just darker).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if brightness decreased and structure preserved, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: brightness reduction and structure preservation
